Job details:
Join a collaborative engineering team developing secure full stack applications that directly contribute to national defense readiness

This Jobot Job is hosted by: Madeline Lazarus

Salary: $90,000 - $115,000 per year

A bit about us:

We are a technology organization supporting defense initiatives through the development, integration, and sustainment of software solutions used across naval operations. Our engineering teams build secure, maintainable systems that contribute directly to mission readiness across submarine, carrier, and shore-based environments while operating within collaborative agile development frameworks.

We are seeking an early-career Full Stack Software Engineer to support software development activities across mission-critical Navy systems. This individual will participate in software design, integration, validation, troubleshooting, and deployment efforts while contributing to secure, maintainable applications across multiple environments.

Location: Manassas, VA • Onsite • Occasional travel to Navy or customer integration locations as needed

Why join us?
• Sign-on bonus
• Medical, dental, and vision coverage
• Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
• Life insurance
• 401(k) with company contribution matching
• Paid holidays and PTO
• Tuition reimbursement and training support

Job Details
• Develop, integrate, test, and maintain software applications supporting Navy operational systems
• Build and enhance full stack applications using Java and JavaScript technologies
• Participate in agile sprint planning, development cycles, reviews, and retrospectives
• Troubleshoot software defects and system integration challenges
• Produce maintainable, readable, documented code aligned with engineering standards
• Support validation, software integration, and deployment activities
• Contribute to technical documentation and configuration management efforts
• Collaborate with software engineers and technical stakeholders in laboratory and operational environments

Must have Skills:
• U.S. Citizenship required
• Active Secret Clearance preferred
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field; equivalent experience considered
• 0–3 years software engineering or systems integration experience
• Java / J2EE development experience
• JavaScript framework experience including React or Vue
• Relational database experience including Oracle or PostgreSQL
• Understanding of Hibernate / JPA concepts
• Familiarity with Agile development methodologies

Nice to have:
• WildFly or JBoss EAP
• Maven
• GitLab
• Docker
• Linux environments
• AWS technologies
• DevSecOps exposure
• Problem-solving and troubleshooting capability
• Adaptability in changing technical environments
• Strong software quality mindset
